description: Implement tokenize(expr) that splits a math expression string into a list of token dicts with 'type' and 'value' fields. Token types: NUMBER (integers), PLUS, MINUS, STAR, SLASH, LPAREN, RPAREN.

files.tests/test_tokenizer.py:
from src.tokenizer import tokenize

def test_simple_addition():
    tokens = tokenize('3 + 4')
    assert tokens == [
        {'type': 'NUMBER', 'value': '3'},
        {'type': 'PLUS', 'value': '+'},
        {'type': 'NUMBER', 'value': '4'},
    ]

def test_complex_expr():
    tokens = tokenize('(10 - 2) * 3')
    assert tokens == [
        {'type': 'LPAREN', 'value': '('},
        {'type': 'NUMBER', 'value': '10'},
        {'type': 'MINUS', 'value': '-'},
        {'type': 'NUMBER', 'value': '2'},
        {'type': 'RPAREN', 'value': ')'},
        {'type': 'STAR', 'value': '*'},
        {'type': 'NUMBER', 'value': '3'},
    ]

def test_division():
    tokens = tokenize('8 / 2')
    assert tokens == [
        {'type': 'NUMBER', 'value': '8'},
        {'type': 'SLASH', 'value': '/'},
        {'type': 'NUMBER', 'value': '2'},
    ]

def test_multi_digit():
    tokens = tokenize('123 + 456')
    assert len(tokens) == 3
    assert tokens[0] == {'type': 'NUMBER', 'value': '123'}
    assert tokens[2] == {'type': 'NUMBER', 'value': '456'}

def test_no_spaces():
    tokens = tokenize('1+2')
    assert tokens == [
        {'type': 'NUMBER', 'value': '1'},
        {'type': 'PLUS', 'value': '+'},
        {'type': 'NUMBER', 'value': '2'},
    ]
